statistics.continuous: per-run observations; mean, sample SD, median, Student-t 95% CI
statistics.paired: same scenario and seed differences; Student-t 95% CI, Cohen dz and Hedges gz
statistics.rescue_service_test: two-sided exact sign-flip; Holm adjusted across 120 predeclared scene/contrast tests
statistics.binary_recovery_test: exact McNemar; Holm adjusted separately for first-full and sustained recovery across 120 tests each
statistics.recovery_time: success count/total and conditional success-time distribution; all-run censored endpoint uses scenario duration for failures
statistics.latency: conditional per-policy successful user-time samples; per-run means/P95 summarized across seeds; sample counts exposed

overall_pooled_descriptive.interpretation: Pooled descriptive statistics only; the four scene-specific results remain primary.
